name: DisElect
observes: Whether a model produces requested components of a localised election-disinformation workflow.
doesNotObserve: Persuasion, exposure, reach, belief change, vote change, agency transfer, or electoral effect.

name: Anthropic agentic influence
construct: Raw capability to execute a simulated influence campaign
metric: Average share of 70 fixed success criteria completed
observes: End-to-end performance in voter-suppression and domestic-polarization scenarios with simulated platform tools and friction.
doesNotObserve: Deployed-model safeguards, real campaign reach, human persuasion, belief or vote change, or electoral effect.

name: APE
observes: Whether a prompted model attempts to shape beliefs or behaviour across benign and harmful topics.
doesNotObserve: Persuasion success, exploitation of a real person, durable belief change, or manipulation efficacy.

name: MASK
observes: Whether a model contradicts an elicited belief when pressured or incentivised to lie.
doesNotObserve: Factual accuracy, persuasion, harmful manipulation, human response, or electoral use.

name: DeepMind harmful manipulation
metric: Cue prevalence plus belief or behaviour outcomes
observes: Context-specific manipulative behaviour and effects in nine controlled studies with 10,101 participants.
doesNotObserve: Default safeguards on prohibited content, electoral deployment, population-scale effects, or durable agency transfer.
modelPeriod: Single tested system; multiple domains and locales

name: Anthropic persuasiveness
construct: Short-run opinion shift after a written argument
observes: Relative persuasiveness of arguments from Claude generations and human writers on emerging policy issues.
doesNotObserve: Harmful manipulation, multi-turn targeting, behaviour, persistence, or real-world political outcomes.

name: InfoOpsBench
observes: Contemporary model performance across information-operation tasks under a common external protocol.
doesNotObserve: Human persuasion, campaign reach, electoral effect, agency transfer, or historical snapshots not actually tested.
